title: Rate Every Song
description: Build your personal music history by rating songs as you discover them. Your ratings help shape the community's taste and create a lasting record of what you've listened to.

title: Keep a Music Diary
description: Every rating becomes an entry in your diary. Track when you discovered a song, revisit your listening journey, and see how your taste evolves over time.

title: Curate & Share Playlists
description: Create custom playlists for any mood, moment, or genre. Share them with the community and discover collections curated by listeners with similar taste.

title: Write Reviews That Matter
description: Go beyond the rating. Write detailed reviews, share your thoughts on tracks that move you, and join conversations about the music that matters.

title: Follow Music Lovers
description: Connect with listeners who share your taste. Follow users to see their latest ratings, reviews, and playlists in your personalized activity feed.

title: Discover Through Community
description: Browse trending songs, explore top-rated albums, and find your next favorite track through the collective wisdom of music lovers everywhere.
